messages.author: 85679393b8bc3d9b
messages.subject: plotRefToTarget visualization
parts:
Hi all,

I visualized meshes using plotRefToTarget associated with min and max PC1 output from phylogenetic PCA (pPCA) and PCA. However, visualizations of the shape changes associated with PC1 min and PC1 max (images attached) from both approaches didn't seem to agree. Based on observations of the meshes I'm not sure what to interpret for PC1 as pPCA and PCA appear to describe different shape changes for PC1 min and max. Is this the result of using phylogeny in pPCA and not in PCA?

Thanks,
Nick

messages.author: 511e44c7d1e1bab0
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] plotRefToTarget visualization
parts:
NIck,

PCA and phylogenetic PCA do different things, so it is natural that they provide different results. The first rotates your data to their main axis of variance. The second rotates your data to their main axis of variance, after taking into account the expected variance due to the phylogeny. Which you choose to interpret is a matter of what view of your data you want. I recommend looking at both, as they can both be informative. A thorough read of the paper of Polly et al 2013 Hystrix 24: 33-41 would help you in understanding the details of the differences between the two and enhance your interpretations.

Hope this helps

Antigoni
